Highly recommended!
Thank you so much, team Esmailjee Moosabhai, for the wonderful service.

featured_reviews.name: Dashrath kumar Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of my favourite shops around my house and area ...!! The rates are reasonable and I have the advantage to walking just a skip and getting the items I need...!!

There is one plus point of the shop which is the range and variety of things available... The shop has been in existence for over a decade or more and it is one stop solution for all the items I need for household civil works...!! They have  scaled up more than others.

Service and  representative at the counter is very smiling and engaging...!! He is polite and well behaved...!! So that itself is the first reason for me to choose this shop...!!

Normally, I try first here and then go to other places later...!!
